title: Wesbrook Park
description: 1 playground in Wesbrook Park (Wesbrook Village, UBC), with an outdoor fitness corner (KOMPAN) and a bouldering wall at its south side. Not in the City of Vancouver open data; the position is where the survey photos were taken. The tube slide tower is by Corocord (2019, ages 5-12). Also has a post with three red rings whose use is unknown.
description_ja: Wesbrook Park（UBC の Wesbrook Village）にある遊び場 1 か所。南側に屋外の運動器具の一角（KOMPAN 社）と登り壁がある。市のオープンデータには無く、位置は現地調査の写真を撮った地点。すべり台の塔は Corocord 社製（2019 年、5〜12 歳向け）。赤い輪が 3 つ付いた、用途の分からない柱もある。
location: Wesbrook Village, University of British Columbia, Vancouver, BC

title: Mundell Park
description: 1 playground in Mundell Park (Wesbrook Village, UBC), next to an open lawn. Not in the City of Vancouver open data; the position is where the survey photos were taken. The play structure was crowded on the survey day, so only part of the equipment has been recorded; to be photographed again.
description_ja: Mundell Park（UBC の Wesbrook Village）にある遊び場 1 か所。芝生の広場の隣にある。市のオープンデータには無く、位置は現地調査の写真を撮った地点。調査の日は複合遊具に人が多く、遊具は一部しか記録できていない。撮り直す予定。
location: Wesbrook Village, University of British Columbia, Vancouver, BC

title: Brockhouse Park
description: Splash pad in Brockhouse Park (Wesbrook Village, UBC), next to the community centre: a round pad with boulders set in the concrete and ground spray nozzles, and a water-play channel lined with boulders, with a water wheel. Dry in October. No play structure was seen on the survey day. Not in the City of Vancouver open data; the position is where the survey photos were taken.
description_ja: Brockhouse Park（UBC の Wesbrook Village）の水遊び場。コミュニティセンターの隣にある。コンクリートに岩を据えた丸い水遊び場で、床に噴水の吹き出し口がある。岩で縁取った水路があり、水車が付く。10 月は水が止まっている。調査の日に複合遊具は見当たらなかった。市のオープンデータには無く、位置は現地調査の写真を撮った地点。
location: Wesbrook Village, University of British Columbia, Vancouver, BC
subject: Water/Spray Parks

title: Kids Tree Canopy Adventure
description: Children's play area among the trees at the top of Grouse Mountain: treehouses joined by net bridges, a tube slide down the slope, a vertical climbing net and a wooden footbridge. The sign says it is for ages 3 and up and adult supervision is required. Outside the City of Vancouver (District of North Vancouver) and inside the paid area of the Grouse Mountain resort (reached by the Skyride), so it is an exception to the rule of recording only playgrounds open to everyone. Not in the City of Vancouver open data; the position is where the survey photos were taken.
description_ja: Grouse Mountain の山頂の、木々の間の子どもの遊び場。網の橋でつながったツリーハウス、斜面へ下りる筒形のすべり台、縦に登る網、木の橋がある。看板によれば 3 歳以上が対象で、大人の付き添いが要る。バンクーバー市の外（ノースバンクーバー郡）で、Grouse Mountain のリゾートの有料の区域（Skyride で上がる）の中にある。誰でも入れる遊び場だけを記録する決まりの例外として載せた。市のオープンデータには無く、位置は現地調査の写真を撮った地点。
location: Grouse Mountain, District of North Vancouver, BC

title: Eagles Park
description: 1 small playground in Eagles Park (UBC) for young children: two spring riders and a low play structure of curved panels with peepholes. Not in the City of Vancouver open data; the position is where the survey photos were taken.
description_ja: Eagles Park（UBC）にある小さい子向けの遊び場 1 か所。スプリング遊具 2 つと、のぞき穴の付いた曲面の板で囲んだ低い遊具。市のオープンデータには無く、位置は現地調査の写真を撮った地点。
location: University of British Columbia, Vancouver, BC

title: Jim Taylor Park
description: 1 playground in Jim Taylor Park (UBC): a wooden play structure with a green spiral slide, a sloping cargo net and a coil climber, a log climbing wall, and a wooden frame with monkey bars. Not in the City of Vancouver open data; the position is where the survey photos were taken.
description_ja: Jim Taylor Park（UBC）にある遊び場 1 か所。緑のらせんのすべり台、斜めの綱の網、らせんの登り棒が付いた木の複合遊具、丸太の登り壁、雲梯を渡した木の枠がある。市のオープンデータには無く、位置は現地調査の写真を撮った地点。
location: University of British Columbia, Vancouver, BC

title: Hawthorn Park
description: 2 play areas in Hawthorn Park (UBC). North: spring riders, a spring seesaw and a small slide tower. South: a metal climbing frame with a slide, a bowl-shaped spinning seat and a standing spinner. Not in the City of Vancouver open data; the position is where the survey photos were taken.
description_ja: Hawthorn Park（UBC）にある遊び場 2 か所。北側にスプリング遊具、ばねのシーソー、小さなすべり台の塔。南側にすべり台の付いた金属の登り枠、おわん形の回る椅子、立って回る遊具。市のオープンデータには無く、位置は現地調査の写真を撮った地点。
location: University of British Columbia, Vancouver, BC
